lead.headline: Tuten is still in a slot nobody can cover, two days on
lead.deck: Move him to FLEX and Gordon to RB before Sunday noon. Waddle has practised fully all week and is a live fallback.
lead.body: Bad news first: your lineup has not changed since Wednesday afternoon, and Bhayshul Tuten went from a limited Wednesday to no practice Thursday with his ankle and foot. Diggs is in FLEX, Gordon is on the bench, and every back you own locks at 12:00 Sunday. If Jacksonville declare Tuten inactive at 13:55, nobody can replace him. Put Gordon in an RB slot and Tuten in FLEX. It is the projection lineup, and it makes Waddle (15:25, full practice all week) and Diggs (Monday) live fallbacks. Jaguars On SI expects Tuten to play; Friday's report decides how much this matters. Thursday night is in: Fairbairn 6.0 in Houston's 26-3 win.

players.caption: Gordon: the RB the fix starts

cards.headline: Start Tuten from FLEX, so Waddle or Diggs can replace him
cards.reason: Limited Wednesday, DNP Thursday with the ankle/foot. In an RB slot, every replacement locks at 12:00.
rows: Before 12:00 Sunday, when Gordon and Warren lock
Ollie Gordon II to RB, Tuten to FLEX, Diggs to the bench
Jaylen Waddle (15:25) or Stefon Diggs (Mon) into FLEX at 13:55

roster.deck: The projection lineup starts Gordon over Diggs (0.9, a coin flip). Tuten belongs in FLEX so his fallback is still live at 13:55.
